entry.title: LAB401: Return to standard operations 🎉
entry.content:
With COVID-19 restrictions eased in France, Lab401's logistics chain has resumed standard operations.

Specifically, this means:

  • Free shipping world-wide for orders over 50€
  • < 24 hour order processing
  • The ability to go outside and order a baguette

We're proud to have been able to continue service throughout quarantine lockdowns, and even happier to be back to full-scale operations.

In what will no doubt be a challenging period ahead, the entire team is here to assist in any way we can to get your business back to normal as soon as possible.

Steve,
on behalf of the Lab401 team 🐹

entry.title: COVID19 Update
entry.summary:
Lab401's warehousing and logistics are based in France, which introduced restrictions to non-essential commerce on March 14. After two weeks of data, we can confirm Lab401's operations

  • Order processing operational (< 24h)
  • Customer Support operational (< 24h)
  • Shipping operational but modified

The postal systems are saturated. To guarantee your delivery we are sending all shipments via courier.

For European Shipments:

  • Paid shipping increased to 19€ All shipments via courier
  • Free shipping from €250
  • Urgent / Express shipping is operational

For International Shipments:

  • Standard Shipments Suspended
  • Urgent / Express shipping is operational

More
entry.content:
Lab401's warehousing and logistics are based in France, which introduced restrictions to non-essential commerce on March 14. After two weeks of data, we can confirm Lab401's operations

  • Order processing operational (< 24h)
  • Customer Support operational (< 24h)
  • Shipping operational but modified

Regular postal systems are saturated; to guarantee your delivery we are sending all shipments via courier. Likewise, we are providing free insurance with all shipments during this time.

For European Shipments:

  • Paid shipping increased to 19€ All shipments via courier
  • Free shipping from €250
  • Urgent / Express shipping is operational
  • Some EU destinations are restricted.
    • Italy: No deliveries to: Ariano Irpino, Polla, Sala Consilina, Atena Lucana, Caggiano, Medicina, Montebello Ionico et San Lucido
    • Portugal: No deliveres to Ovar

For International Shipments:

  • Standard Shipments Suspended
  • Urgent / Express shipping is operational
  • Some destinations are restricted.
    • Singapore: Deliveries to company addresses are suspended until May 7.
    • South Africa: Deliveries are suspended until the end of restrictions.
    • Argentina, Bolivia, Ecuador, Panama, Peru and Venuzuella: Deliveries are suspended until the end of restrictions.

Full information is available via our carrier: https://www.chronopost.fr/en/flash-infos/04072020-international-shipping-covid-19

Please note, although orders are processed and dispatched within 1 business day, we have noticed that the courier services are experiencing delays before processing new packages. This is out of our control, and appears to fluctuate from same-day to up to 3 business days.

We will update this thread if and when the situation changes.

In the meantime, we are using the imposed quarantine to put the finishing touches on new products.

Stay safe and informed -

Steve and the Lab401 Team
